# source: float manual (the [H] placement specifier and the \newfloat,
# \floatstyle, \restylefloat, \listof commands). [H] is impl by agreement,
# not by code: floats here always stand where declared — the package's
# "put it HERE" is the engine's only placement model — so loading the
# package changes nothing and its specifier is honoured by construction.
# New float classes and float styles stay refused by name.
body impl \begin{figure}[H]\caption{a caption}\end{figure}
body impl \begin{figure}[htbp]\caption{a caption}\end{figure}
body refuse:W0301 \newfloat{program}{tbp}{lop}
body refuse:W0301 \floatstyle{ruled}
body refuse:W0301 \restylefloat{table}
body refuse:W0301 \listof{program}{List of Programs}
